intuition: Two half-open bookings conflict exactly when their intervals overlap with positive length.

brute_force.approach: Check every existing booking for overlap before appending a new one.

optimal.approach: Keep bookings sorted by start and inspect only the predecessor and successor around the insertion point.
optimal.time: book O(log n) search plus O(n) insertion

edge_cases: An event ending exactly when another begins is allowed.
A rejected booking must not change the stored intervals.
